caption: The drawing depicts a garment, specifically a short, cape-like cloak with wide, flowing sleeves. The garment is primarily dark green in color, with a textured shading that suggests a soft, perhaps velvet-like fabric. Decorative elements are present: a pattern of evenly spaced yellow or gold dots that form two downward-facing triangles, one at the neckline and one on the lower back. The edges of the cloak are embellished with a yellow or gold zigzag trim, with additional smaller dots and blue wave-like edged detail outlining the hem and cuffs. The inside neckline reveals an orange-brown inner lining, and there is subtle patterning, possibly floral, on the inner edge near the neck. The composition is centered on a plain, light beige background, and the artist's signature, "P. Romano," is located in the lower right corner beneath the image.
title: Jacket
